title: Graceful fallback: telemetry-guarded regional restart and soft circuit dampener
author: Priya Rao
release_notes:
- Introduces telemetry-guarded restart window to avoid cascade restarts across regions.
- Adds a soft circuit dampener (region-level) that prevents rapid open/close flips during rolling restarts.
- Exposes new metrics (slo_trend_score, restart_holdoff_seconds) for SLO-driven restart orchestration.
- Backwards compatible: defaults are conservative and toggled by config flags for Dedicated/Private customers.
description:
Summary: Add a telemetry-guarded restart orchestration and a soft circuit dampener to reduce cascade failures during region/restart operations. Motivation: During the Feb 10 incident we observed coordinator-driven rolling restarts triggering collateral SLO violations in adjacent regions when restart timing overlapped with transient KV pressure and increased tail latency. This change prevents restarts from progressing for a region while its SLO trend is degrading and reduces circuit flipping noise by adding a soft dampener that increases reopen cooldown when restarts are in-flight.

What I changed (single-line sections for CI parsing):
- runtime/shedder/guard.go: new SLOTrendGuard that consumes slo_trend_score and decides restart_holdoff_seconds.
- controlplane/prober/restart_coordinator.go: restart sequencing extended to consult SLOTrendGuard and to annotate restart tickets with telemetry snapshot.
- circuit/dampener.go: implement soft dampener that adds exponential reopen debounce when restart context is present.
- telemetry/metrics_registry.go: add slo_trend_score and restart_holdoff_seconds metrics, and small tagging for restart_context.
- observability/alerts.yaml: add alert rule to surface prolonged holdoffs and sidecar KV pressure correlation.
- docs/ops/restart-playbook.md: describe new restart gating, metrics to watch, and manual override steps.
- test/guard_test.go + test/dampener_integration_test.go: unit + integration tests covering gating and cooldown behavior.

Commits (high-level):
- a1b2c3: initial implementation of SLOTrendGuard and config knobs.
- b2c3d4: integrate guard into RestartCoordinator; add telemetry snapshotting.
- c3d4e5: add soft dampener; tune reopen cooldown parameters.
- d4e5f6: add metrics + alerts and update docs.
- e5f6g7: fix flaky test and update mocks for prober (CI failure rerun).

Files changed (high level):
- runtime/shedder/guard.go (+210/-12)

Small snippet (for reviewers):
- runtime/shedder/guard.go: decision loop (illustrative):
  func (g *SLOTrendGuard) ShouldHoldoff(region string) bool {
      score := g.telemetry.CurrentSLOTrend(region) // score in [-1.0, +1.0] where negative is degrading
      if score < g.config.HoldoffThreshold {
          g.log.Infof("Holdoff: region=%s score=%0.2f holdoff=%ds", region, score, g.config.BaseHoldoffSeconds)
          return true
      }
      return false
  }

Testing and CI: Initial CI run reported a flaky integration test in prober mocks (test/dampener_integration_test.go) caused by timing assumptions. I updated the test to use a deterministic simulated clock and increased a debounce margin; CI was re-run and passed. Checks: unit (pass), integration (pass after rerun), lint (pass), e2e (smoke) (pass). Final CI status: pass.

Review convo (highlights captured as single string):
- Marcus Delgado: "Can we avoid adding a new metric name per region when high cardinality customers are enabled? Consider using tags and sampling."
  - Priya Rao (author): "Agree. metrics_registry now reuses existing region tag and uses gauge sampling; updated tests to assert tag presence rather than new metric series per tenant."
- Ethan Park: "This looks good but please ensure the restart_holdoff_seconds is exposed as a debug-only gauge for some customers until we validate in staging."
  - Priya Rao: "Added defaults.yaml flag restart_holdoff_exposure=staging_only and gate for Private/Dedicated config. Docs updated."
- Lina Soto: "Circuit dampener parameters look conservative; can we add a feature flag for rapid rollback if we see negative impact?"
  - Priya Rao: "Added feature flag circuit.soft_dampener.enabled (default true) and backout instructions in docs/ops/restart-playbook.md."

Rollout plan / mitigation:
- Step 1: Merge to main and deploy to staging with restart_holdoff_exposure=staging_only for 48h.
- Step 2: Observe slo_trend_score correlation with in-flight restarts; verify no increase in 99th P90 failures and KV pressure.
- Step 3: Flip exposure for a small subset of Dedicated customers via config and monitor.
- Backout: disable circuit.soft_dampener.enabled and set restart_holdoff_exposure=off, then restart coordinator service if necessary.

Related work / context: Linked to ENG-4321 (restart orchestration stabilizer) and SUP-1274 which reported collateral SLO degradations during a coordinated rolling restart. This PR is intentionally conservative — all gating is opt-in via config flags and metrics exposure is default-staged to avoid surprise telemetry costs.

Why this is different from previous PRs: many prior fixes focused on shedding or eviction logic; this change focuses on preventing operator-triggered or automation-triggered restarts from amplifying transient infra signals by coordinating with SLO trends and by dampening circuit reopen behavior only while a restart is ongoing.

Manual verification steps:
- In staging: trigger a simulated restart in region "eu-west-1" with slo_trend_score artificially dropped to -0.6; confirm RestartCoordinator defers restart and emits restart_holdoff_seconds metric and log line.
- Verify dampener prevents rapid circuit reopen by toggling a short failure window and checking that reopen backoff increases (exponential) while restart_context tag present.

Notes: teammates oncall were notified for post-merge monitoring window (24h). This PR was merged via squash after approvals from all reviewers and successful CI re-run.
